## Purpose
Explain the problem and why this change is needed.

## Changes
Summarize the behavior and scope.

## Validation
List commands run and results. Explain any tests that could not run.

## Risk and rollback
Describe compatibility, data migrations, security impact, and rollback steps.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests or validation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials or private customer data are committed.
- [ ] Documentation and operational notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] A human reviewer has assessed the change before merge.
